fact_text: Pakistan fixed medicine prices from 2000 to 2015; from FY16 the drug regulator linked price changes to CPI, allowing non-essential medicines a gap of up to 10% and essential medicines up to 7%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What's Behind GSK's Massive Earnings And Will The Stock Price Surge Continue? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-03)

fact_text: In late 2023 the drug regulator allowed essential medicine prices to rise by up to 14% and non-essential medicine prices by up to 20%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What's Behind GSK's Massive Earnings And Will The Stock Price Surge Continue? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-03)

fact_text: In February 2024 hardship cases were allowed price increases for medicines whose selling price was below their cost of production.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What's Behind GSK's Massive Earnings And Will The Stock Price Surge Continue? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-03)

fact_text: In April 2024 the regulator deregulated non-essential medicine prices, so the government stopped controlling them; the reporter said this was the main driver of higher sector profitability.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What's Behind GSK's Massive Earnings And Will The Stock Price Surge Continue? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-03)

fact_text: In 2021-23 active pharmaceutical ingredient prices spiked, inflation reached about 30% and the rupee depreciated sharply, which put profitability across pharma companies under distress.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What's Behind GSK's Massive Earnings And Will The Stock Price Surge Continue? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-03)

fact_text: Active pharmaceutical ingredients are the major raw material for drugmakers, and their prices multiplied in 2021, which dented company profitability; the reporter did not expect API prices to rise in the near term.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What's Behind GSK's Massive Earnings And Will The Stock Price Surge Continue? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-03)

fact_text: The overall pharma sector imports about 10-15% of its ingredients and raw materials from India, so geopolitical tension could cause a minor hit.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What's Behind GSK's Massive Earnings And Will The Stock Price Surge Continue? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-03)

fact_text: Some voices called for the government to fix drug prices again after the 2024 deregulation; re-regulation would be a threat to pharma company profitability, in the reporter's view.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What's Behind GSK's Massive Earnings And Will The Stock Price Surge Continue? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-03)

fact_text: GSK Pakistan is one of the leading pharmaceutical companies in Pakistan; its major sponsor GSK International holds about 85% and the free float is about 15%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What's Behind GSK's Massive Earnings And Will The Stock Price Surge Continue? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-03)

fact_text: GSK Pakistan demerged its consumer healthcare business in 2015-16, and a global demerger in 2021-22 led to the consumer business taking the GSK consumer healthcare name; the Pakistan company is a medicines business.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What's Behind GSK's Massive Earnings And Will The Stock Price Surge Continue? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-03)

fact_text: GSK Pakistan's medicines range covers antibiotics, dermatology and painkillers, and about 50% of its revenue comes from antibiotics.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What's Behind GSK's Massive Earnings And Will The Stock Price Surge Continue? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-03)

fact_text: Augmentin is GSK Pakistan's largest brand, with a sales value of about 11 billion (currency not clearly stated in the video).
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What's Behind GSK's Massive Earnings And Will The Stock Price Surge Continue? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-03)

fact_text: Gross margin rose from a low of about 7% in 2023 to about 25% in 2024, which the reporter attributed mainly to higher selling prices; the margin then peaked at a record high of about 34%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What's Behind GSK's Massive Earnings And Will The Stock Price Surge Continue? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-03)

fact_text: Trailing four-quarter profit rose from about PKR 6.5 billion to about PKR 8 billion as the company's profitability improved.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What's Behind GSK's Massive Earnings And Will The Stock Price Surge Continue? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-03)

fact_text: Quarterly earnings per share were about Rs 3 three quarters before the latest, about Rs 9 in the quarter before it, and about Rs 7 in Q1 CY25.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What's Behind GSK's Massive Earnings And Will The Stock Price Surge Continue? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-03)

fact_text: On 2025-05-03 the share price was below Rs 370, well under its high of about Rs 468.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What's Behind GSK's Massive Earnings And Will The Stock Price Surge Continue? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-03)

fact_text: The stock traded at about 15 times calendar 2024 earnings and about 14 times trailing twelve-month earnings, according to the reporter's comparison.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What's Behind GSK's Massive Earnings And Will The Stock Price Surge Continue? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-03)

fact_text: The reporter's analysis expects gross margins to rise from the 34% peak to about 38-40%, lifting year-end CY25 profitability to about Rs 30-32 per share.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What's Behind GSK's Massive Earnings And Will The Stock Price Surge Continue? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-03)

fact_text: Across several valuation methods the reporter's fair value range is about Rs 500-600 per share, implying about 30-35% upside from the sub-Rs 370 price.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What's Behind GSK's Massive Earnings And Will The Stock Price Surge Continue? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-03)

fact_text: The most important risk to valuation is PKR depreciation, since the company imports about 70-80% of its raw materials from several countries.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What's Behind GSK's Massive Earnings And Will The Stock Price Surge Continue? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-03)

fact_text: A renewed API price spike would hit the company's profitability and valuation, as happened in 2021; the reporter did not expect API prices to rise in the near term.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What's Behind GSK's Massive Earnings And Will The Stock Price Surge Continue? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-03)
